item.stem:
The diagram shows a $3$ by $1$ by $1$ solid of unit cubes on an isometric grid. Sameer wants to read its length, depth, and height from the grid.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: Count $3$ units along length, $1$ along depth, and $1$ along height using the three isometric grid directions.
options.B: Count only on a square grid; the three isometric directions are not needed.
options.C: The three isometric grid directions are produced by the $3$ by $1$ by $1$ solid.
options.D: Add $3+1+1$ on one axis to get the solid's size.
